answer: The chatbot described in arXiv 2505.11946 uses both public and proprietary standards to support AI compliance by integrating these standards into its framework, allowing users to access a comprehensive repository of legal and ethical guidelines. This integration enables the chatbot to provide tailored guidance and real-time, context-aware compliance verification. By including both public regulations and company-owned standards—whether they are proprietary regulations developed internally or industry standards acquired by the organization—the chatbot streamlines the regulatory adherence process, reduces complexity, and fosters responsible AI development. This approach empowers developers and organizations to efficiently navigate the complex regulatory landscape and ensure their AI systems are compliant with the most up-to-date standards.
